input.question: Why can quitting drinking kill an alcoholic?
input.ground_truth: With heavy/long-term use, alcohol creates big changes in the alcoholic's brain chemistry and body. When an alcoholic suddenly stops drinking, the brain's systems basically go haywire with the sudden change. Areas that were constantly excited by the constant alcohol are now pretty quiet, and other areas that were constantly quieted by the alcohol "wake up" and freak out, leading to seizures, heart strain, shaking, anxiety, etc. While that alone can be fatal, if the alcoholic has other health issues, the extra strain on the body can cause problems there and lead to death, particularly with underlying heart issues. As an aside, a friend was just talking about this the other day and said that quitting alcohol is so dangerous compared to quitting other drugs because of how deeply the alcohol penetrates into the brain. Other drugs are slowed/stopped by the blood-brain barrier, remaining mostly on the surface of the brain or in the bloodstream, but alcohol is able to pass through.

Question: Why can quitting drinking kill an alcoholic?

response.prediction:
Okay, let's imagine you have a toy car that needs special fuel to run. Every day, you give it that special fuel, and it works fine. But one day, you stop giving it the special fuel and only give it water. The toy car doesn't run and might even break because it needs that special fuel to work.

Now, think of the special fuel as the alcohol that someone drinks. Some people's bodies get used to having alcohol all the time, and their body starts to need it to feel okay. This is called being an alcoholic.

If someone who is an alcoholic suddenly stops drinking, their body gets very confused and upset, because it's used to having alcohol. Their body starts to act strange and can get very sick, sometimes so sick that it can be dangerous or even cause death. This is called "withdrawal," and it's very hard on the body.

So, quitting drinking all at once can be very dangerous for someone who is an alcoholic because their body gets very sick without the alcohol it's used to having. That's why they need help from doctors to stop safely.
